newsitem.title: TURKEY: NEW TURK MINISTER SAYS BALANCED BUDGET UNREALISTIC.
newsitem.headline: NEW TURK MINISTER SAYS BALANCED BUDGET UNREALISTIC.

text.p: Turkey's new state minister for the economy, Gunes Taner, said on Monday a balanced budget target set by the former Islamist-led government was not realistic and a supplementary budget would soon be needed.

"A supplementary budget will have to come before parliament soon," Taner told reporters during the handover of the state ministry. President Suleyman Demirel earlier on Monday approved conservative Prime Minister Mesut Yilmaz's three-party coalition government.
